# Kyro-Workspace I

> Kyro-Workspace I is a free, local-first AI study workspace that turns PDF documents into summaries, study notes, quizzes, flashcards, plain-English explanations and learning paths.

Kyro-Workspace I runs entirely in the browser. Users add PDF files, text is extracted locally with pdf.js, and only the extracted text is sent directly to OpenRouter models for generation. There are no accounts, no application servers and no tracking: the API key stays in localStorage and saved notes stay in IndexedDB.

Website: https://quantivelle.github.io/Kyro-Workspace/
Source: https://github.com/Quantivelle/Kyro-Workspace

## Pages

- [Landing page](https://quantivelle.github.io/Kyro-Workspace/index.html): public entry point — what the tool does, how it works, the AI modes, privacy and FAQ, with a prominent "Launch Tool" button into the app.
- [Kyro-Workspace I tool](https://quantivelle.github.io/Kyro-Workspace/app.html): the single-file web application — upload a PDF, then generate summaries, notes, quizzes, flashcards, simplified explanations and more.
- [Privacy policy](https://quantivelle.github.io/Kyro-Workspace/privacy.html): local-first architecture, zero server storage, no tracking or analytics.
- [License](https://quantivelle.github.io/Kyro-Workspace/license.html): Apache License 2.0 (code only; the Quantivelle and Kyro-Workspace I names and the Quantivelle logo are not licensed).
- [Trademarks](https://quantivelle.github.io/Kyro-Workspace/trademarks.html): rules for use of the Quantivelle and Kyro-Workspace I names and the Quantivelle logo.

## Features

- PDF extraction and a multi-file document library
- AI summary, Q&A, study notes and plain-English simplification
- Quiz generation with MCQ, true/false, fill-in-the-blank, case study and HOTS questions
- Flashcards with active recall, revision and exam-brainstorm modes
- Saved notes with folders, tags, search and bulk actions
- Fully local storage: API key in localStorage, notes in IndexedDB
- Automatic lite mode on slow networks and low-end devices
- Self-hosted fonts and vendored libraries, with no CDN requests at runtime

## Audience

Students, teachers, researchers and professionals who read long PDFs and want revision material without uploading their documents.
